# Flock components

Library version 1.10.10. Import from `./flock/ui` (path relative to `src/`). Use these before writing your own UI;
style custom code with the theme variables in `src/flock/theme/flock/tokens.css`, never raw colours.

**Editors open in place.** An add or edit form opens where it was asked for: directly under the row, item, card or slot that was
clicked, pushing what is below it down; never at the top of the page or anywhere else. Table, RowList, Gallery, Board, Schedule and
Calendar (timeline, schedule) take `expanded` for this; in a list you lay out yourself, wrap the form in `InlinePanel` right after the
item. Both focus the first field, close on Escape and hand focus back to the control clicked. A page's own Add button in the header
opens its form right under the header. Editing a record on its own page (reached by navigation) and a Confirm before a delete are fine.

**Layout.** A screen is built from the frame components, and `check-app` refuses a page that breaks these rules:
- A screen is one `Page`, at the top. Its body is Sections, Columns and boxes; Columns holds one Section or box per column.
- A box (`Card`, a `Section` with `emphasis="subtle"`, `Callout`, `InlinePanel`) never holds another box. Inside a box, space things
  with `Stack` and put them side by side with `Row`; `Columns` lays out a page or a section, never the inside of a box.
- Spacing comes from the scale: `Stack`/`Row` `gap` (xs 4px, sm 8px, md 12px, lg 18px), and in your own CSS `var(--space-1…7)`,
  `var(--gap-page)`, `var(--gap-section)`, `var(--gap-box)`, `var(--pad-box)`. Never a `style={{ margin, padding, gap }}` in a page.

## App frame

### Page

The frame of one app page: a title, a subtitle, an actions slot and the content.

```tsx
<Page title="Launch tracker" subtitle="6 workstreams" actions={<Button>New</Button>}>…</Page>
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | no | page heading, rendered as the h1 |
| `subtitle` | string | no | one muted line under the title |
| `actions` | ReactNode | no | buttons shown at the right of the heading |
| `width` | "narrow" \| "wide" \| "full" | no | wide (default), narrow, full |
| `children` | ReactNode | yes | the page content |

### Section

A titled block of content inside a page, with an optional actions slot.

```tsx
<Section title="Overdue" emphasis="subtle">…</Section>
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | no | section heading |
| `actions` | ReactNode | no | buttons shown at the right of the heading |
| `emphasis` | "plain" \| "subtle" | no | plain (default), or subtle for a soft panel |
| `children` | ReactNode | yes | the section content |

### Columns

Lays its children side by side in columns; they stack under 720px.

```tsx
<Columns ratio="2:1"><Section title="Board">…</Section><Section title="Notes">…</Section></Columns>
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ratio` | "1:1" \| "2:1" \| "1:2" \| "1:1:1" | no | column widths, 1:1 (default), 2:1, 1:2, 1:1:1 |
| `children` | ReactNode | yes | one child per column |

### Stack

Children one under another, spaced by the scale. Space a custom block's parts with it, never with margins.

```tsx
<Stack gap="sm"><Heading>Dinner</Heading><Value kind="money" value={420} /></Stack>
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gap` | "xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" | no | space between children: xs, sm, md (default), lg |
| `align` | "start" \| "center" \| "end" | no | cross-axis alignment; stretch when unset |
| `children` | ReactNode | yes | the things to stack |

### Row

Children side by side, spaced by the scale, wrapping. Inside a box, use it instead of Columns.

```tsx
<Row justify="between"><span>Total</span><Value kind="money" value={1240} /></Row>
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gap` | "xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" | no | space between children: xs, sm (default), md, lg |
| `align` | "start" \| "center" \| "end" \| "baseline" | no | cross-axis alignment, center by default |
| `justify` | "start" \| "between" \| "end" | no | main-axis placement; between pushes the first and last apart |
| `wrap` | boolean | no | wrap onto more lines when they do not fit (default true) |
| `children` | ReactNode | yes | the things to lay side by side |

### Tabs

Pill tabs for switching between views of a page; arrow keys move the selection.

```tsx
<Tabs tabs={[{ id: "board", label: "Board" }, { id: "list", label: "List", count: 12 }]} value={tab} onChange={setTab} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tabs` | { id: string; label: string; count?: number /* small number shown after the label */; icon?: string /* lucide icon name shown before the label */ }[] | yes | the tabs, in order |
| `value` | string | yes | id of the selected tab |
| `onChange` | function | yes | called with the id of the tab chosen |

### AppShell

The app's frame: header with object icon and sharers, page navigation (none, top tabs or left nav) and the agent chat placement.

```tsx
<AppShell name="Budgets" object="wallet" pages={pages} current={page} onNavigate={setPage} chat={{ placement: "side", render: () => <AgentChat /> }}>…</AppShell>
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | the app's name, shown in the header (not inside Flock, whose bar already names the app: there the header goes and the tabs come first) |
| `subtitle` | string | no | one muted line under the name |
| `object` | string | no | object sticker name for the header, e.g. 'house' |
| `nav` | "auto" \| "none" \| "top" \| "side" | no | auto (default): 1 page none, 2-4 top tabs, 5+ left nav (left nav when chat is a page) |
| `pages` | { id: string; label: string; icon?: string /* lucide icon name */ }[] | no | the pages to navigate between |
| `current` | string | no | id of the current page |
| `onNavigate` | function | no | called with the id of the page chosen |
| `people` | { name: string }[] | no | people the app is shared with, shown as avatars |
| `accent` | "coral" \| "teal" \| "blue" \| "green" \| "violet" \| "amber" | no | the app's own accent by name: coral (default), teal, blue, green, violet or amber; set once, never a hex colour |
| `chat` | { placement: "side" \| "page"; render: function /* returns the AgentChat element */ } | no | agent chat: a side panel (a launcher on phones) or its own page |
| `settings` | { render: function /* returns the app's own settings page */ } | no | the owner's Settings & routines page: inside Flock the signed-in owner gets a last page "Settings" (Flock's own page for this app by default; visitors never see it); pass only to draw your own |
| `theme` | "system" \| "light" \| "dark" | no | system (default), light or dark; the viewer can switch |
| `children` | ReactNode | yes | the current page's content |

### AgentChat

Chat with the app's agent, beside the data or as a page; sends the open record as context, shows changed rows with Undo, lists saved chats.

```tsx
<AppShell name="Villas" chat={{ placement: "side", render: () => <AgentChat placement="side" context={selected ? { table: "villas", id: selected.id, label: selected.name } : null} /> }}>…</AppShell>
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `placement` | "side" \| "page" | yes | side: a docked panel (the shell turns it into a launcher on phones); page: conversation list and thread side by side |
| `context` | { table: string; id: string; label: string /* shown on the chip, e.g. 'Villa Azul' */ } \| null | no | the record the viewer is looking at; sent with each message until the chip is cleared |
| `starters` | string[] | no | suggested first messages, shown on an empty conversation |
| `title` | string | no | header text; default 'Ask <agent name>' |

### MiniApp

A small framed app for a chat reply: a title, optional pill tabs (Tab children), and a Make it an app button.

```tsx
<MiniApp title="Coorg weekend" subtitle="15–16 Nov" makeApp><Tab label="Plan">…</Tab><Tab label="Costs">…</Tab></MiniApp>
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | yes | the frame's title |
| `subtitle` | string | no | small caps line above the title |
| `makeApp` | boolean | no | show the 'Make it an app' button |
| `onMakeApp` | function | no | called when 'Make it an app' is pressed |
| `children` | ReactNode | yes | Tab elements, or any content when there are no tabs |

### Tab

One pill tab inside MiniApp; its children show when the tab is open.

```tsx
<Tab label="Plan" count="3">…</Tab>
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string | yes | the tab's text |
| `count` | string | no | a small count or note after the label |
| `children` | ReactNode | yes | the tab's content |

## Text

### Heading

```tsx
<Heading level={1} subtitle="Updated just now">Good evening</Heading>
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `level` | 1 \| 2 \| 3 | no | 1 page title, 2 section (default), 3 sub-section |
| `children` | ReactNode | yes | the title text |
| `subtitle` | string | no | one muted line under the title |

### Markdown

Formatted text from markdown; raw HTML is dropped and only http, https and mailto links are kept.

```tsx
<Markdown text={"**Next step:** [open the brief](https://example.com)"} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes | markdown source, e.g. an agent's reply or a note |

### Callout

A short highlighted note with a tone and an optional icon.

```tsx

```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tone` | "neutral" \| "accent" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "info" \| "muted" | no | neutral (default), accent, success, warning, danger, info, muted |
| `icon` | string | no | lucide icon name shown before the title |
| `title` | string | no | bold lead that says what the note is about |
| `children` | ReactNode | yes | the note text |

### Bullets

A plain bulleted list of short strings.


| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|

### Divider

A thin rule between groups of content.

```tsx
<Divider />
```

No props.

## Data views

### Calendar

Dates as a month, a week strip, a week grid or a day timeline. For a weekly plan prefer Schedule; keep week-grid as its option.

```tsx
<Calendar view="week-grid" rows={meals} date={(m) => m.date} title={(m) => m.dish} lane={(m) => m.slot} lanes={["Breakfast","Lunch","Dinner"]} weekStart="2026-10-05" today="2026-10-08" onAdd={(d, slot) => addMeal(d, slot)} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `view` | "month" \| "schedule" \| "week-grid" \| "timeline" | yes | month grid, schedule (week strip + that day's list), week-grid (days × lanes, e.g. meals), timeline (grouped by day) |
| `rows` | any[] | yes | the records to place on dates |
| `date` | function | yes | (row) => ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD' the row falls on |
| `title` | function | yes | (row) => what to show for the row (ReactNode) |
| `time` | function | no | (row) => 24h HH:MM time text such as '09:30'; rows sort by it within a day |
| `tone` | function | no | (row) => neutral \| accent \| success \| warning \| danger \| info \| muted; colours the row's edge |
| `lane` | function | no | (row) => which lane the row belongs to, for week-grid |
| `lanes` | string[] | no | week-grid lane order, e.g. ['Breakfast','Lunch','Dinner']; default is the order lanes first appear |
| `icon` | function | no | (row) => lucide icon name shown as a tinted tile before the title (timeline) |
| `trailing` | function | no | (row) => ReactNode placed at the end of the row, e.g. a vote button; clicks on it do not select the row (timeline) |
| `selectedId` | string | no | id of the picked row; highlighted in timeline, schedule, week-grid and month |
| `weekStart` | string | no | ISO date of the Monday the week starts on (schedule, week-grid); month shows this date's month |
| `today` | string | no | ISO date to mark as today with the app accent |
| `onSelect` | function | no | (row) => void, called when a row is picked |
| `onAdd` | function | no | (date, lane?) => void, called from the + on an empty day or cell |
| `expanded` | { at: string /* the row's key (its id) */; content: ReactNode /* the form or detail to show, usually a Card holding a Form */; onClose: function /* () => void, called on Escape: close it as Cancel does */; label?: string /* accessible name, e.g. 'Edit Rice' */ } \| null | no | opens content in place (timeline and schedule views) under the row whose id is `at`, pushing the rows below down: the add or edit form for the row clicked, never one at the top of the page. It focuses its first field, Escape calls onClose, and focus returns to the control clicked |

### Schedule

Dated items one block per day from today, today and tomorrow big, later days compact; the default for any weekly plan.

```tsx
<Schedule rows={meals} date={(m) => m.date} title={(m) => m.dish} slot={(m) => m.slot} slots={["Breakfast","Lunch","Dinner"]} secondary={(m) => m.cook && `${m.cook} cooks`} days={7} onAdd={(d, slot) => setAdding({ d, slot })} onSelect={openMeal}
  expanded={adding ? { at: scheduleAddKey(adding.d, adding.slot), label: "Add a meal", onClose: () => setAdding(null), content: <MealForm … /> } : null} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rows` | any[] | yes | the records to place on dates |
| `date` | function | yes | (row) => ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD' the row falls on |
| `title` | function | yes | (row) => what to show for the row (ReactNode) |
| `time` | function | no | (row) => left label shown as text, such as '10 – 11am' or '09:30'; it is display only |
| `start` | function | no | (row) => start of the row for ordering within a day: 'HH:MM' or minutes since midnight; default reads the leading time of `time` ('9 – 10am' before '10 – 11am', '9am' before '1pm') |
| `secondary` | function | no | (row) => muted text after the title (location, notes, tags); shown in full on today and tomorrow |
| `tone` | function | no | (row) => neutral \| accent \| success \| warning \| danger \| info \| muted; colours the row's dot and edge |
| `icon` | function | no | (row) => lucide icon name shown as a tinted tile on today and tomorrow |
| `trailing` | function | no | (row) => ReactNode placed at the end of the row, e.g. a vote button; clicks on it do not select the row |
| `slot` | function | no | (row) => which slot the row fills, e.g. 'Breakfast'; shown as its left label |
| `slots` | string[] | no | slot order such as ['Breakfast','Lunch','Dinner']; today and tomorrow then show an inviting '+ Add breakfast' row for each empty slot |
| `today` | string | no | ISO date of today; default is the viewer's local date, refreshed at midnight |
| `from` | string | no | ISO date the list starts on; default is today. Days before today fold behind an 'Earlier' toggle |
| `days` | number | no | how many days to show from `from`; default 7 |
| `showEarlier` | boolean | no | start with the days before today open instead of folded, e.g. when browsing a past week |
| `selectedId` | string | no | id of the picked row; highlighted |
| `onSelect` | function | no | (row) => void, called when a row is picked |
| `onAdd` | function | no | (date, slot?) => void, called from an add row or the Add button of a day |
| `rowKey` | function | no | (row) => stable key per row; defaults to row.id |
| `expanded` | { at: string /* the row's key (its id) */; content: ReactNode /* the form or detail to show, usually a Card holding a Form */; onClose: function /* () => void, called on Escape: close it as Cancel does */; label?: string /* accessible name, e.g. 'Edit Rice' */ } \| null | no | opens content in place under the row whose key is `at`, or under the '+ Add' whose `scheduleAddKey(date, slot?)` is `at` (a folded empty day unfolds for it), pushing the rows below down: the add or edit form for the row clicked, never one at the top of the page. It focuses its first field, Escape calls onClose, and focus returns to the control clicked |

### Table

Rows and columns from one table; values formatted by kind; paged with Load more.

```tsx
<Table rows={rows} columns={[{ key: "name", label: "Name" }, { key: "amount", label: "Amount", kind: "money", align: "end" }]} hasMore={hasMore} onLoadMore={loadMore}
  expanded={editing ? { at: editing.id, label: `Edit ${editing.name}`, onClose: () => setEditing(null), content: <Card title="Edit"><Form … onCancel={() => setEditing(null)} /></Card> } : null} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rows` | Record<string, any>[] | yes | the rows loaded so far: an id and one field per column key each |
| `columns` | ({ key: string /* field name on the row */; label: string; kind?: "text" \| "number" \| "money" \| "compact" \| "signed" \| "percent" \| "share" \| "date" \| "select" \| "multi" \| "person" \| "url" \| "checkbox" \| "minutes" /* how to show the value: text (default), number, money, compact, signed, percent (signed change, +12.0%), share (plain 64%), date, select, multi, person, url, checkbox, minutes */; tones?: Record<string, "neutral" \| "accent" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "info" \| "muted"> /* for kind select: option -> tone */; labels?: Record<string, string> /* for kind select: stored value -> the words shown */; align?: "start" \| "end" /* end for numbers */; width?: "auto" \| "narrow" \| "wide"; phone?: "hide" /* hide this column from the row cards shown on phones (up to 720px); on phones each row is a card: the wide (else first) column is the title, an align end column sits at the right of it, select/multi/person/date values are chips, the rest are Label: value lines */; render?: function /* custom cell; replaces the kind formatting. In phone cards use native controls (a, button, input) or role/tabindex for clickable content so it works on its own */ })[] | yes | the columns, in order: key (row field), label, and optionally kind, tones, labels, align, width, phone, render |
| `onRowClick` | function | no | called with the row clicked or activated with Enter |
| `selectedId` | string | no | id of the highlighted row |
| `loading` | boolean | no | true while any page is fetching: skeleton when there are no rows yet, otherwise Load more spins |
| `error` | string \| null | no | shown instead of the table when there are no rows; with rows loaded it is a notice under them |
| `empty` | ReactNode | no | shown when there are no rows |
| `hasMore` | boolean | no | true when the server has more pages |
| `onLoadMore` | function | no | fetch the next page; the Load more button calls it |
| `density` | "compact" \| "comfortable" | no | comfortable (default) or compact row height |
| `rowKey` | function | no | stable key per row; defaults to row.id |
| `expanded` | { at: string /* the row's key (its id) */; content: ReactNode /* the form or detail to show, usually a Card holding a Form */; onClose: function /* () => void, called on Escape: close it as Cancel does */; label?: string /* accessible name, e.g. 'Edit Rice' */ } \| null | no | opens content in place under the row whose key is `at` (a full-width row on desktop, under the card on phones), pushing the rows below down: the add or edit form for the row clicked, never one at the top of the page. It focuses its first field, Escape calls onClose, and focus returns to the control clicked |


| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rows` | Record<string, any>[] | yes | the rows loaded so far |
| `title` | function | yes | main line of a row |
| `meta` | function | no | small grey line under the title |
| `leading` | function | no | left slot, e.g. an icon or avatar |
| `trailing` | function | no | right slot, e.g. a status pill or amount |
| `onRowClick` | function | no | called when a row is clicked or activated with Enter |

| `empty` | ReactNode | no | shown when there are no rows |
| `hasMore` | boolean | no | true when the server has more pages |
| `onLoadMore` | function | no | fetch the next page |
| `rowKey` | function | no | stable key per row; defaults to row.id |
| `expanded` | { at: string /* the row's key (its id) */; content: ReactNode /* the form or detail to show, usually a Card holding a Form */; onClose: function /* () => void, called on Escape: close it as Cancel does */; label?: string /* accessible name, e.g. 'Edit Rice' */ } \| null | no | opens content in place under the row whose key is `at`, pushing the rows below down: the add or edit form for the row clicked, never one at the top of the page. It focuses its first field, Escape calls onClose, and focus returns to the control clicked |

### StatStrip

One row of 2–5 key numbers; never a grid of number cards.

```tsx

```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stats` | ({ label: string; value: number \| string; kind?: "text" \| "number" \| "money" \| "compact" \| "signed" \| "percent" \| "share" \| "date" \| "select" \| "multi" \| "person" \| "url" \| "checkbox" \| "minutes" /* number (default for numbers), money, compact, share, minutes, text; share shows a plain 64%, percent a signed change (+12.0%) */; delta?: number /* percent change, shown green or red */; hint?: string /* tooltip */ })[] | yes | 2 to 5 stats, shown in one row |

It focuses its first field, Escape calls onClose, and focus returns to the control clicked |

### Gallery

A grid of image cards with a designed placeholder when an image is missing.

```tsx
<Gallery rows={recipes} image={(r) => r.cover} object={(r) => r.object} title={(r) => r.name} meta={(r) => r.time} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rows` | Record<string, any>[] | yes | the records to show as cards |
| `image` | function | no | image url for a card; null or empty shows the placeholder |
| `object` | function | no | object name drawn on a card with no image, on a tinted cover |
| `title` | function | yes | card title |
| `meta` | function | no | small line under the title |
| `onClick` | function | no | called when a card is clicked |
| `loading` | boolean | no | true shows a skeleton before the first rows arrive, and spins Load more after |
| `error` | string \| null | no | a load error; shown alone when there are no rows, otherwise as a notice under the grid |
| `empty` | ReactNode | no | shown when there are no rows (an Empty with a hint and action) |
| `hasMore` | boolean | no | true shows Load more under the grid |
| `onLoadMore` | function | no | called when Load more is clicked |
| `columns` | 2 \| 3 \| 4 | no | fixed column count; default fits as many as the width allows |
| `rowKey` | function | no | stable key per row; defaults to row.id |
| `expanded` | { at: string /* the row's key (its id) */; content: ReactNode /* the form or detail to show, usually a Card holding a Form */; onClose: function /* () => void, called on Escape: close it as Cancel does */; label?: string /* accessible name, e.g. 'Edit Rice' */ } \| null | no | opens content in place as a full-width band right under the card whose key is `at`, pushing the rows below down: the add or edit form for the row clicked, never one at the top of the page. It focuses its first field, Escape calls onClose, and focus returns to the control clicked |

### Chart

A small line, bar or share (allocation) chart from rows; theme colours only.

```tsx
<Chart type="line" kind="money" data={[{ label: "May", income: 262000, expenses: 171000 }]} series={[{ key: "income", label: "Income", tone: "success" }, { key: "expenses", label: "Expenses", tone: "danger" }]} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | "line" \| "bar" \| "share" | yes | line and bar plot every series over the labels; share is one bar split by the first series' values |
| `data` | ({ label: string; [key: string]: number \| string })[] | yes | one object per point: a label plus a number per series key (numbers, never text such as '₹1,200'); line points oldest first |
| `series` | ({ key: string /* field on each data row */; label: string; tone?: "neutral" \| "accent" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "info" \| "muted" /* defaults cycle through accent, info, success, warning, danger */ })[] | yes | the lines or bars to draw: key (field on each data row), label and optional tone |
| `kind` | "text" \| "number" \| "money" \| "compact" \| "signed" \| "percent" \| "share" \| "date" \| "select" \| "multi" \| "person" \| "url" \| "checkbox" \| "minutes" | no | money or compact formats the y-axis as ₹ with k / L / Cr; share adds % (percent is the same here) |
| `height` | number | no | plot height in px at full width (default 200); the chart scales down on phones |

### BigCard

A large card with a title, an optional big value, a caption and chips; for a highlighted option or fact.

```tsx
<BigCard label="Plan B" title="Annual" value={9900} kind="money" unit="/ year" caption="Two months free" chips={["Cancel anytime"]} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string | no | small uppercase tag above the title, e.g. 'Option A' |
| `title` | string | yes | the card's name or headline |
| `value` | string \| number | no | the big figure shown on the card: a price, a time or a count; leave it out when there is none, never an id or slug |
| `kind` | "text" \| "number" \| "money" \| "compact" \| "signed" \| "percent" \| "share" \| "date" \| "select" \| "multi" \| "person" \| "url" \| "checkbox" \| "minutes" | no | how to show the value: number (default for numbers), money, compact, share, minutes, text |
| `unit` | string | no | small unit after the value, e.g. '/ month' |
| `caption` | string | no | one or two lines of context under the value |
| `chips` | string[] | no | short facts shown as chips |
| `image` | string | no | a photo of the option (a product, a dish, a place): an https image address exactly as a tool or the site gave it, never made up |
| `facts` | ({ label: string; value: string \| number; kind?: "text" \| "number" \| "money" \| "compact" \| "signed" \| "percent" \| "share" \| "date" \| "select" \| "multi" \| "person" \| "url" \| "checkbox" \| "minutes" /* text by default; number for numbers */ })[] | no | labelled rows under the caption, for comparing cards side by side: give every card the same labels in the same order (at most 8) |

## Records

### Card

A bordered container with a title, a meta line and an actions slot; clickable when onClick is set.

```tsx
<Card title="Venue" meta="Due Fri" actions={<Button size="sm" variant="soft">Edit</Button>}>Hall booked for 40.</Card>
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | ReactNode | no | heading line |
| `meta` | ReactNode | no | small grey line under the title |
| `actions` | ReactNode | no | buttons shown at the right of the header |
| `onClick` | function | no | makes the whole card a button |
| `children` | ReactNode | no | the card body |
| `emphasis` | "plain" \| "subtle" | no | subtle uses a quieter background |

### InlinePanel

An add or edit form opened in place under the item clicked: focuses its first field, Escape closes, focus goes back.

```tsx
{goals.map((g) => <Fragment key={g.id}><GoalRow goal={g} onEdit={() => setEditing(g.id)} />{editing === g.id ? <InlinePanel label={`Edit ${g.goal}`} onClose={() => setEditing(null)}><Card title="Edit goal"><Form … /></Card></InlinePanel> : null}</Fragment>)}
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | ReactNode | yes | the form or detail, usually a Card |
| `onClose` | function | yes | () => void, called on Escape; close the panel here, as Cancel does |
| `label` | string | no | the panel's accessible name, e.g. 'Edit Rice' |
| `className` | string | no | extra class for custom layout |

### Detail

Label and value pairs for one record, each value formatted by its kind.

```tsx
<Detail fields={[{ label: "Owner", value: row.owner, kind: "person" }, { label: "Budget", value: row.budget, kind: "money" }]} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fields` | ({ label: string; value: any /* text, or a number formatted by kind (rupees for money, YYYY-MM-DD for a date) */; kind?: "text" \| "number" \| "money" \| "compact" \| "signed" \| "percent" \| "share" \| "date" \| "select" \| "multi" \| "person" \| "url" \| "checkbox" \| "minutes" /* how to show the value; text by default */; tones?: Record<string, "neutral" \| "accent" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "info" \| "muted"> /* for kind select: value to tone */; labels?: Record<string, string> /* for kind select: stored value to the words shown */ })[] | yes | label and value pairs, in order; kind says how to show each value |
| `sample` | boolean | no | pass the record's _sample: the values are lighter and a Sample chip heads the list |

### PropertyChips

A wrapping row of small label and value chips, for a record's key facts.

```tsx
<PropertyChips items={[{ label: "Cost", value: 1200, kind: "money" }, { label: "Where", value: "Goa" }]} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | ({ label: string; value: any; kind?: "text" \| "number" \| "money" \| "compact" \| "signed" \| "percent" \| "share" \| "date" \| "select" \| "multi" \| "person" \| "url" \| "checkbox" \| "minutes" /* text by default */; tones?: Record<string, "neutral" \| "accent" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "info" \| "muted"> /* select only: option → tone */ })[] | yes | label and value pairs shown as small chips; kind says how to show each value |

### Checklist

Tick-off items with an optional detail line, groups, a progress bar and an inline add row.

```tsx
<Checklist items={rows.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, label: r.title, done: r.done }))} onToggle={(id, done) => save(id, { done })} showProgress />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | { id: string; label: string; done: boolean; meta?: string /* one line of detail under the label */; group?: string; sample?: boolean /* pass the row's _sample: shown lighter with a Sample chip */ }[] | yes | the items: id, label, done, and optionally meta, group and sample |
| `onToggle` | function | yes | called with (id, done) where done is the new state |
| `onAdd` | function | no | called with (label, group?) when Enter is pressed in the add row; the row only shows when this is set |
| `style` | "task" \| "note" | no | task has square boxes (default), note has round ones |
| `grouped` | boolean | no | one heading per item group, with a done count |
| `showProgress` | boolean | no | a 'N of M' line and a progress bar on top |

### LineItems

Editable invoice lines (description, qty, price, GST %) with line amounts and a subtotal, tax and total block.

```tsx
<LineItems rows={lines} onChange={setLines} split={sameState ? "intra" : "inter"} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rows` | ({ id?: string; description: string; qty: number \| null; unit_price: number \| null; gst_rate: number \| null })[] | yes | the lines: description, qty, unit_price in rupees and gst_rate in percent |
| `onChange` | function | no | called with the whole new array of rows when a field changes or a row is added or removed; omit for a read-only block |
| `rates` | number[] | no | the GST rates offered, default [0, 5, 18, 40]; a Custom % entry (0-100, two decimals) is always added |
| `split` | "intra" \| "inter" \| "none" | no | intra shows CGST and SGST halves (default), inter shows IGST, none one Tax line |
| `totals` | { label: string; value: number; strong?: boolean }[] | no | the totals block to show instead of the one worked out here, e.g. from the server; the last row is the grand total |
| `readOnly` | boolean | no | show the rows as text even when onChange is set |
| `addLabel` | string | no | label of the add-a-row button, default 'Add a line' |
| `noTax` | boolean | no | the seller is not registered for GST: no GST column or rate pickers, no tax in the worked-out totals, new lines at 0% |

## Inputs

### Button

An action button: ink (primary), app (accent), soft, ghost, danger; optional loading state and split menu.

```tsx
<Button variant="app" icon="plus" onClick={add}>Add</Button>
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | "ink" \| "app" \| "soft" \| "ghost" \| "danger" | no | ink (default) primary, app uses the app accent |
| `size` | "sm" \| "md" | no | md (default) or sm for tight spots |
| `icon` | string | no | lucide icon name shown before the label |
| `loading` | boolean | no | shows a spinner and disables the button; the label stays so width holds |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | greys the button out and ignores clicks |
| `onClick` | function | no | called on click |
| `type` | "button" \| "submit" | no | default button |
| `children` | ReactNode | yes | the label |
| `menu` | { label: string; onSelect: function /* called when the item is picked */ }[] | no | when present the button becomes a split button with a More menu |

### Form

A stack of Fields with a submit button; blocks on Required, shows server field errors, disables while saving.

```tsx
<Form fields={[{ type: "text", name: "item", label: "Item", required: true }, { type: "money", name: "budget", label: "Budget" }]} onSubmit={add} errors={serverErrors} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fields` | ({ type: "text" \| "longtext" \| "number" \| "money" \| "date" \| "select" \| "multi" \| "checkbox" \| "person" \| "url"; name: string; label: string; options?: string[]; required?: boolean; error?: string \| null; placeholder?: string })[] | yes | the inputs, in order; each has a type, a name (the key in the submitted values), a label, and optionally options (select, multi), required, placeholder |
| `initial` | Record<string, any> | no | starting values by field name |
| `onSubmit` | function | yes | called with the values object; may return a promise, the button shows loading until it settles |
| `submitLabel` | string | no | default Save |
| `onCancel` | function | no | shows a Cancel button when set |
| `errors` | Record<string, string> | no | server errors by field name, e.g. from a 400 { field, message }; cleared on edit |

### Field

One labelled input of a given type, with an error tied to it. Controlled: you own value and onChange.

```tsx
<Field type="money" name="budget" label="Budget" value={budget} onChange={setBudget} error={err} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | "text" \| "longtext" \| "number" \| "money" \| "date" \| "select" \| "multi" \| "checkbox" \| "person" \| "url" | yes | number and money give onChange a number or null; date gives an ISO string; multi gives a string array |
| `name` | string | yes | the input's name attribute; with a Form, the key in the submitted values |
| `label` | string | yes | text shown above the input |
| `value` | any | yes | current value; its shape follows type |
| `onChange` | function | yes | called with the new value, or null when emptied |
| `options` | string[] | no | select and multi: the choices. text: suggestions only (a datalist; any text is accepted) |
| `optionLabels` | Record<string, string> | no | select only: the words shown for an option's value (the value stays what was stored) |
| `required` | boolean | no | marks the field as required |
| `error` | string \| null | no | shown under the field and read out with it |
| `placeholder` | string | no | hint text shown while the input is empty |
| `onInvalid` | function | no | number and money only: called with true while the typed text is not a number, false otherwise |

### FilterPill

A pill-shaped dropdown filter: the field name in grey, the chosen option, and Any for none.

```tsx
<FilterPill label="Status" options={["Open", "Done"]} value={status} onChange={setStatus} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string | yes | the field name, e.g. Status |
| `options` | string[] | yes | the choices offered, besides Any |
| `value` | string \| null | yes | the chosen option, or null for Any |
| `onChange` | function | yes | called with the option, or null when Any is picked |

### DateRange

From and To date pickers with quick presets (this week, this month, last 30 days, this year).

```tsx
<DateRange from={range.from} to={range.to} onChange={setRange} presets={["this-month", "last-30"]} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string \| null | yes | ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or null |
| `to` | string \| null | yes | ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or null |
| `onChange` | function | yes | called with { from, to } |
| `presets` | ("this-week" \| "this-month" \| "last-30" \| "this-year")[] | no | which quick buttons to show; all four by default, [] for none |
| `today` | string | no | ISO date to treat as today; for tests and demos |

### Search

A search box with a magnifier that calls onChange after the user pauses typing.

```tsx
<Search value={q} onChange={setQ} placeholder="Search vendors" />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | string | yes | the current search text |
| `onChange` | function | yes | called with the text once typing pauses |
| `placeholder` | string | no | also the accessible name; default Search |
| `debounceMs` | number | no | pause before onChange fires; default 250, 0 for immediate |

### SlotPicker

One day's time slots as tappable chips; taken slots stay visible but cannot be picked.

```tsx
<SlotPicker open="09:00" close="18:00" slotMinutes={30} taken={["10:00", "10:30"]} value={time} onChange={setTime} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | string | yes | first start time of the day as 'HH:MM' (24 hour), e.g. '09:00' |
| `close` | string | yes | closing time as 'HH:MM'; a slot must end by then |
| `slotMinutes` | number | yes | minutes between slot starts, e.g. 30 |
| `taken` | string[] | no | start times ('HH:MM') that cannot be picked; they show struck through |
| `past` | string[] | no | start times already gone today; disabled and read out as passed, and a day with none left says 'No more times today.' |
| `value` | string \| null | no | the picked start time 'HH:MM', or null |
| `onChange` | function | yes | called with the picked start time 'HH:MM' |
| `length` | number | no | minutes the booking needs, when longer than a slot; a slot that would end after closing is left out |
| `label` | string | no | accessible name of the group; default 'Time slots' |

### Choice

A question with 2 to 8 options, as buttons or big cards, plus a field to write your own answer.

```tsx
<Choice question="When suits you?" options={["Sat 4pm", "Sun 11am"]} onAnswer={(a) => send(a)} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `question` | string | no | the question, shown above the options |
| `tab` | string | no | short tab label when this question sits inside Questions |
| `options` | string[] \| ({ label?: string /* small uppercase tag above the title, e.g. 'Option A' */; title: string /* the card's name or headline */; value?: string \| number /* the big figure shown on the card: a price, a time or a count; leave it out when there is none, never an id or slug */; kind?: "text" \| "number" \| "money" \| "compact" \| "signed" \| "percent" \| "share" \| "date" \| "select" \| "multi" \| "person" \| "url" \| "checkbox" \| "minutes" /* how to show the value: number (default for numbers), money, compact, share, minutes, text */; unit?: string /* small unit after the value, e.g. '/ month' */; caption?: string /* one or two lines of context under the value */; chips?: string[] /* short facts shown as chips */; image?: string /* a photo of the option (a product, a dish, a place): an https image address exactly as a tool or the site gave it, never made up */; facts?: ({ label: string; value: string \| number; kind?: "text" \| "number" \| "money" \| "compact" \| "signed" \| "percent" \| "share" \| "date" \| "select" \| "multi" \| "person" \| "url" \| "checkbox" \| "minutes" /* text by default; number for numbers */ })[] /* labelled rows under the caption, for comparing cards side by side: give every card the same labels in the same order (at most 8) */ })[] | yes | 2 to 8 options: all plain strings, or all cards (title is what gets sent back) |
| `multi` | boolean | no | allow several picks, sent together with the submit button |
| `write` | boolean | no | show the 'Or write your own answer…' field; default true |
| `submitLabel` | string | no | multi only: the submit button's text; default 'Send' |
| `onAnswer` | function | yes | called with { picked: string[] } or { written: string } |

### ItemPicker

Items with a photo, price and a quantity stepper, in group tabs, and one button that sends the picks.

```tsx
<ItemPicker items={menu.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, name: d.name, price: d.price, image: d.photo, group: d.section }))} onSubmit={(picked) => addToCart(picked)} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | ({ id: string; name: string; meta?: string /* one short line under the name: veg or not, rating, pack size */; price?: number \| string /* the price of one, in rupees */; image?: string /* a photo of the item: an https address exactly as a tool or the page gave it */; group?: string /* the section it is in (a menu's Bestsellers, Combos); with 2 or more groups each is a tab */; max?: number /* the most of it one order takes; default 20 */ })[] | yes | the items to pick from, in the order to show them |
| `submitLabel` | string | no | the button that sends the picks; default 'Add to cart' |
| `onSubmit` | function | yes | called with [{ id, name, qty }] for every item picked |

### ProductCards

Product cards with photos per colour, colour and size picks that switch price and stock, a cart and one Checkout.

```tsx
<ProductCards pickedSize="M" items={shirts} onSubmit={(cart) => checkout(cart)} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | { id: string; title: string; brand?: string; rating?: { stars: number; count?: number } /* as the page shows it */; badge?: string /* a label the page shows, such as Amazon's Choice */; bullets?: string[] /* up to 3 short feature lines from the page */; details?: string /* the longer description from the page, shown under More details */; url?: string /* the product page address; the title links to it */; photos?: { image: string /* a photo: an https address exactly as the page gave it */; alt?: string /* what the photo shows (front, back, detail) */ }[] /* the default photos, used for a colour with none of its own */; colours?: { name: string; swatch?: string /* a css colour for the swatch */; image?: string /* a swatch photo address, when the page gives one */; photos?: { image: string /* a photo: an https address exactly as the page gave it */; alt?: string /* what the photo shows (front, back, detail) */ }[] /* this colour's photos, as the page shows them */ }[] /* the colours on the card (every colour the site sells, or the first few of many) */; moreOptions?: { colours?: number; sizes?: number } /* colours and sizes the site sells that are not read onto the card yet; a button asks you to read them all */; moreColours?: number /* how many more colours the site sells than are on the card; the card says so and links to the page */; sizes?: string[] /* the sizes read, in order (up to 10) */; variants: { id: string /* the site's variant id (an ASIN) */; colour?: string /* a colour name above */; size?: string /* a size above */; price?: number /* rupees; only when read */; mrp?: number /* rupees; only when read */; delivery?: string /* the delivery date as the page wrote it; only when read */; stock?: string /* a stock note such as Only 3 left; only when read */; available: boolean /* false when the page says it is not sold in this colour and size */ }[] /* one row for every colour and size read */ }[] | yes | up to 10 products, in the order to show them |
| `pickedSize` | string | no | the owner's size; a card opens on a colour that has it |
| `submitLabel` | string | no | the button that sends the cart; default 'Checkout' |
| `onSubmit` | function | yes | called with [{ id, title, colour, size, variantId, price }] for every cart line |

### Questions

2 to 6 Choice questions as pill tabs with one Submit; an answer ticks its tab and moves on.

```tsx
<Questions title="Plan the trip" onChange={save} onSubmit={send}><Choice tab="Dates" question="When?" options={["Sat", "Sun"]} /><Choice tab="Budget" question="How much?" options={["Low", "High"]} /></Questions>
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | no | the frame's title |
| `subtitle` | string | no | small caps line above the title |
| `makeApp` | boolean | no | show the 'Make it an app' button |
| `submitLabel` | string | no | the Submit button's text; default 'Send answers' |
| `onChange` | function | yes | called with all answers so far, keyed by tab label, on every pick, write or change |
| `onSubmit` | function | yes | called once with all answers when Submit is pressed |
| `onMakeApp` | function | no | called when 'Make it an app' is pressed |
| `children` | ReactNode | yes | 2 to 6 Choice elements; each one's tab (else question) is its tab label and its answer key |

## Media

### Icon

A Lucide line icon by kebab-case name; use it below 24px, objects are for larger spots.

```tsx
<Icon name="calendar-days" size={16} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | a lucide icon name, kebab-case, e.g. 'calendar-days' |
| `size` | number | no | pixels, default 16 |

### Avatar

A round initials avatar whose colour is stable for a given name.

```tsx
<Avatar name="Asha" />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | person's name; the first letter is shown |
| `size` | "sm" \| "md" | no | default sm |

### AvatarStack

Overlapping initials avatars for a set of people, with a +N for the rest.

```tsx
<AvatarStack people={[{ name: "Asha" }, { name: "Ben" }]} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `people` | { name: string }[] | yes | people to show, in order |
| `max` | number | no | avatars shown before +N, default 4 |

### Image

A picture at a fixed ratio; an empty or broken source shows a placeholder, optionally with an object.

```tsx
<Image src={row.photo} alt={row.name} ratio="4:3" object="camera" />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string \| null | no | http(s) URL or a /root-relative path; anything else shows the placeholder |
| `alt` | string | yes | what the picture shows |
| `ratio` | "1:1" \| "4:3" \| "16:9" | no | default 1:1 |
| `object` | string | no | object name drawn in the placeholder |

### FileRow

A file with a type badge, name and size; the name links out when the URL is http, https or mailto.

```tsx
<FileRow name="Invoice.pdf" size={48213} href={row.url} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | file name; its extension picks the badge |
| `size` | number | no | bytes, shown as KB/MB |
| `href` | string | no | link target; unsafe schemes are not linked |
| `kind` | string | no | badge text overriding the extension, e.g. 'csv' |

### ObjectIcon

A themed sticker illustration from the app's objects folder, for empty states and cards; use Icon below 24px.

```tsx
<ObjectIcon name="house" size={64} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | object file name without .svg, e.g. 'house'; unknown names render nothing |
| `size` | 24 \| 32 \| 48 \| 64 \| 96 | no | pixels, default 48 |
| `label` | string | no | accessible name; omit when purely decorative |

## States

### Skeleton

Shimmering placeholder bars shown while data loads, in row, card or stat shape.

```tsx
{loading ? <Skeleton variant="card" lines={4} /> : <Table … />}
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lines` | number | no | number of bars, default 3 |
| `variant` | "row" \| "card" \| "stat" | no | shape, default row |

### Empty

The no-data state: a title, a hint, an optional object illustration and an action.

```tsx
<Empty title="No invoices yet" hint="Add the first one." object="receipt" action={<Button onClick={add}>Add invoice</Button>} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | yes | what is missing, e.g. 'No invoices yet' |
| `hint` | string | no | what to do about it |
| `object` | string | no | object name drawn above the title |
| `action` | ReactNode | no | usually a Button |

### ErrorCard

A red alert for a failed load or save, with a Try again button when onRetry is given.

```tsx
<ErrorCard title="Could not load" message={error.message} onRetry={refetch} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | no | short lead |
| `message` | string | yes | what went wrong, in plain words |
| `onRetry` | function | no | runs when Try again is pressed |

### ToastProvider

Wrap the app once; then useToast().show({ message, tone?, action? }) shows a pill for 5 seconds.

```tsx
const { show } = useToast(); show({ message: "Saved", tone: "success", action: { label: "Undo", onClick: undo } });
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | ReactNode | yes | the app |

### Confirm

A small modal that asks before something risky; focus starts on Cancel and Escape cancels.

```tsx
<Confirm open={ask} title="Delete invoice?" tone="danger" confirmLabel="Delete" onConfirm={del} onCancel={() => setAsk(false)} />
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | boolean | yes | whether the dialog is showing |
| `title` | string | yes | the question, e.g. 'Delete this invoice?' |
| `body` | ReactNode | no | one line of consequence |
| `confirmLabel` | string | no | button text, default 'Confirm' |
| `tone` | "danger" \| "ink" | no | danger for destructive actions, default ink |
| `onConfirm` | function | yes | runs when the owner confirms |
| `onCancel` | function | yes | runs on Cancel, Escape or a click outside |

## Values

### Value

Renders one value by kind: money with Indian grouping, compact ₹L/Cr, dates as relative, selects as pills, people as avatars.

```tsx
<Value kind="compact" value={275000} />  // ₹2.75L
```

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | "text" \| "number" \| "money" \| "compact" \| "signed" \| "percent" \| "share" \| "date" \| "select" \| "multi" \| "person" \| "url" \| "checkbox" \| "minutes" | yes | how to show the value; percent = signed change (+12.0%, green or red), share = plain 64% |
| `value` | any | yes | the raw value; empty shows a muted dash |
| `tones` | Record<string, "neutral" \| "accent" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger" \| "info" \| "muted"> | no | select only: option → tone |
| `labels` | Record<string, string> | no | select only: stored value → the words shown (a renamed stage); an unlisted value shows as stored |
| `today` | string | no | ISO date used as 'today' (tests, fixed dashboards) |

## Data and helpers

Import these from `./flock/ui` too. Components never fetch; pages call the hooks and pass rows down.

### useTable(table, query?)

`const { rows, loading, error, hasMore, loadMore, refetch, create, update, remove } = useTable<Row>("tasks", { where: { status: "open" }, sort: "-due", limit: 100, q: "text" })`

- Reads `/api/_data/<table>` a page at a time (default 100, at most 500) and refetches on the server's live events and after a reconnect.
- `create(values)`, `update(id, patch)` and `remove(id)` are optimistic and roll back with a "Couldn't save" toast on failure. `remove` resolves with a `changeId`; POST `_changes/<changeId>/undo` through `kitFetch` to bring the row back.
- `loadMore()` appends the next page; a failure toasts and keeps the rows. `loading` is true while a page is in flight.
- Pass `rows`, `loading`, `error`, `hasMore` and `onLoadMore={loadMore}` straight to Table, RowList or Gallery.

### useRecord(table, id)

`const { row, loading, error, update } = useRecord<Row>("tasks", id)` loads one row (`id` null gives `row: null`), follows live changes to it, and `update(patch)` is optimistic.

### useMe()

`const { viewer, anonymous, agent, loading } = useMe()` says who is looking (`viewer` is null for an anonymous visitor on a public app) and which agent the app has.

### useApp() and label(key, fallback)

`const app = useApp()` gives `{ name, icon, display, settings, loading }` from `/api/_app`: the app's name, its display (`object`, `accent`, `labels`, `starters`) and the owner's settings with their defaults. It is fetched once per page and again when a setting changes. Until it loads, display and settings are empty, so keep the app's own value as the fallback: `accent={app.display.accent ?? "teal"}`, `app.settings.number_prefix ?? "INV-"`.

`label("vendors", "Vendors")` returns the owner's name for a page or object (`display.labels.vendors`), else the fallback. Call `useApp()` in App.tsx so labels re-render when the info arrives. Declare every key you pass to `label` in `flock.app.json` `labels`.

### Sample rows

When an app starts with no data of its own, the kit seeds sample rows and reads mark them `_sample: true`. Table, RowList, Board, Schedule, Calendar and Gallery show such a row lighter (the `--sample` opacity token) with a small "Sample" chip; pass `sample: row._sample` on Checklist items and `sample={row._sample}` to Detail. AppShell shows a one-line banner while any sample exists, with Clear samples (signed-in viewers only); the toast says what was cleared and kept and offers Undo. Editing a sample keeps it as the owner's row. Never filter samples out or restyle them yourself.

### useHashRoute(defaultPage, validPages?)

`const [page, go] = useHashRoute("home", ["home", "settings"])` keeps the page in `#/<page>`, with no router. An unknown hash falls back to the default.

### useChat()

`const { openChat, available } = useChat(); openChat({ message: "Here is what I'd like you to know about me: ", send: false })` opens the app's chat as its launcher does: the side panel on a wide screen, the sheet on a phone, or the Chat page (`placement: "page"`). With `message` the words wait in the chat's typing box for the viewer to finish; `send: true` sends them at once. `available` is false, and `openChat` does nothing, outside AppShell, when the app has no `chat`, or when Flock shows the app beside its own chat. Call it in pages inside the shell. An app built on an older Flock has no `useChat` in `./flock/ui`: declare `"minFlockVersion": "0.22.1"` (the first Flock that ships it) in `flock.app.json` before using it.

### useToast()

`const toast = useToast(); toast.show({ message: "Saved", tone: "success", action: { label: "Undo", onClick } })`. AppShell provides the toasts, so call `useToast` and the data hooks in pages inside the shell, not in the component that renders `<AppShell>`: out there a toast is silently dropped.

### Formatting helpers

- `formatINR(n, { compact?, signed?, abs? })` gives `₹1,20,000`, or `₹1.2L` compact; `formatNumber(n)` groups digits the Indian way; `formatPercentChange(n)` gives `+12.0%`.
- `relativeDate(iso, today?)` gives Today, Tomorrow, Yesterday, or a short date.
- `safeHref(url)` and `safeSrc(url)` return the url only when it is safe (http, https or mailto links; http, https or root-relative images) and null otherwise. Use them for any link or image a user or agent supplied.
